ga_conclusion.interpretation: The GA jointly optimizing (pass-gates AND independent) settled in the independent region (corr ~0) at SH 1.3 -- it could NOT reach the passing region (SH>=2.0) because that region requires the short-interest backbone, which violates corr<0.7.
